requirements.title: Transmit power
requirements.description: The transmitter shall deliver TBD W into a 50 ohm load.
requirements.rationale: SI-001. 47CFR97.999 is a clause of a section absent from the regulatory corpus (SOURCE_UNRESOLVED); MOP-999 is not in tpm.json (MOP_UNRESOLVED).

requirements.title: Receiver sensitivity
requirements.description: The receiver shall detect a 1 uV signal.
requirements.rationale: Needed for range. Only an SI source while expectations.json exists (SOURCE_L0_MISSING).

requirements.title: Duplicate id
requirements.description: The radio shall not reuse identifiers.

requirements.title: Keying
requirements.description: The radio shall accept a straight key and shall accept iambic paddles with adequate timing.
requirements.rationale: Two shalls and a weak word on purpose.

requirements.title: TBR on a Verified requirement
requirements.description: The radio shall weigh at most 350 (TBR) g without the antenna.
requirements.rationale: A tbr object on a Verified requirement is seeded on purpose (T-14).

requirements.title: The radio shall limit RF exposure
requirements.description: The radio must keep the power density at 20 cm below 1.0 mW per square centimeter.
requirements.rationale: Shall in the title, a group A modal verb, and an Analysis exception naming a risk that does not exist are seeded on purpose.
requirements.verification_note: Analysis accepted per RSK-999: no field-strength meter.

requirements.title: L1 requirement with a parent
requirements.description: The radio shall boot to receive within 2 s of power on.
requirements.rationale: A SYS requirement with a non-null parent_id is seeded on purpose (T-05, L1_PARENT_NOT_NULL).

requirements.title: Closed without a SAR memo
requirements.description: The enclosure shall carry the call sign label on the rear face.
requirements.rationale: Closed while docs/reviews/SAR/decision-memo.md is absent and the Passed closing case has no report (CLOSED_WITHOUT_SAR, VERIFIED_WITHOUT_EVIDENCE, TC_STATUS_EVIDENCE).
